description:
Create a Bitcoin inscription - STEP 1: Broadcast commit transaction.

This tool broadcasts the commit tx and returns immediately. It does NOT wait for confirmation.

After the commit confirms (typically 10-60 min), use `inscribe_reveal` with the same contentType and contentBase64 to complete the inscription.

Returns: commitTxid, revealAddress, revealAmount, and feeRate (save these for inscribe_reveal)

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

feeRate.description: Fee rate: 'fast' (~10 min), 'medium' (~30 min), 'slow' (~1 hr), or number in sat/vB (default: medium)

name: inscribe
